probe: BEAM cross-session entity-bridging headroom (zero API, zero LLM reader)
source: beam_001 corpus (external BEAM @ commit 3e120355); measurement-only use of sealed outcome_surface.source_chat_ids
why: Test whether BEAM is a suitable benchmark to show entity-linking HEADROOM, i.e. real gold evidence that the shipped lexical+dense read path cannot reach but an entity (coreference) bridge could.

population.note: knowledge_update has source_chat_ids=null (no evidence-location), so headroom on it cannot be measured without a human pass; multi_session_reasoning spans 2-8 sessions (median 2-3 gold mentions).

methods.bm25: Okapi BM25 (k1=1.5,b=0.75) over user messages, content-word tokens
methods.dense: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B-Q8_0 (1024d) Llama(embedding=True).embed, cosine -- the product embedder, cache was deleted so recomputed for the sample
methods.surface_link_classes: for each missed gold mention: lexical (shares content word w/ question) / entity-only (shares proper-noun, no content word) / none (neither)

tightened_lexical_only_all_152.note: the 2 'entity-only' cases were 'How' capitalization artifacts, not proper nouns

verdict: ENTITY-LINKING HEADROOM ON BEAM multi_session_reasoning ~= 0, exactly as on LoCoMo.
mechanism_attribution: BEAM's cross-session difficulty is AGGREGATION + semantic RECALL of topically-related instances, NOT coreference. Every gold mention visually inspected that both retrievers missed was a distinct sub-instance an aggregation question sums over (e.g. each money-saving event at 'Kocetas', each festival/transport 'choice'), NOT an alias needing resolution. There is no same-entity-under-different-name edge for a resolver to form.
the_real_ceiling_is_not_coreference: 42-59% of gold is unreachable at top-10 by BOTH dense and lexical -- this matches the shipped ~48% CC80 accuracy. It is a dense-semantic-ranking + 32k-budget ceiling. Entity-linking adds nothing to it (no alias edges); the lever is dense recall / representation / budget, a different axis.
implications: BEAM is NOT the venue to certify entity-linking beyond saliency (it has no such headroom).
Two independent benchmarks (LoCoMo 2026-09-23, BEAM 2026-09-24) now show entity-as-sole-bridge headroom ~= 0.
Entity-linking's proven value (LitBank synthetic + real nominal coreference) is a DIFFERENT axis from multi-session long-context memory benchmarks, whose challenge is aggregation/recall.
Do NOT spend the 21,675-call full live arm to test entity-linking on BEAM: the zero-API preliminary shows it cannot fire.
instrument_caveats: Granularity: probed at user-message level; product embeds at episode (user+assistant pair). Directional only.
Query embedding uses no instruction prefix (matches product model.embed). Dense@10 recall 39-47% consistent with product ~48%.
Small dense sample (16 conversations total across seeds); pattern is stable and consistent with the 152-question lexical-only result.
